resources.string: This screen is coming in the next step.
Start planning your first trip: itinerary, packing list and expenses in one place.
Trips you create will show up here, grouped into in progress, upcoming and finished.
Your last trip was %1$s. Where to next?
Expenses in other currencies are converted to %1$s.
If the dates get shorter, activities on removed days move to Unscheduled instead of being deleted.
Everything in this trip is deleted and cannot be restored:
Used for new trips. Existing trips keep their currency.
The currency cannot change after expenses were recorded.
Add the first activity of the day.
Release to reorder. Drag onto a day chip to move to another day.
The day is empty, starting at the default time
Placed at the end of the day automatically. An empty day starts at 09:00.
Day %1$d is packed from %2$s. Durations stay the same, times follow the new order.
No items for %1$s yet. Add the first item and tick them off while packing.
"Add another" saves this item and clears the name; the category stays.
No expenses for %1$s yet. Record every expense so your remaining budget is always clear.
Enter an amount greater than zero
Plan your itinerary day by day
Set activities, times and places for every day. Ideas you are not sure about can wait in "Unscheduled".
Make a packing list per category, then tick items off one by one before you leave.
Record expenses in any currency and see your remaining budget anytime.
Ask first when a drag changes activity times.
Applies right away on this device.
"Follow system" follows your phone's dark mode, including its schedule.
Applies right away on this device.
We can't load this right now. Check your internet connection, then try again.
Something is wrong on our server, not on your device. Your data is safe. Try again in a moment.
Sign in to sync your trips across all your devices.
Use without an account for now
Keep your trips safe and open them on your phone, tablet or the web.
Enter your account email. We will send a link to create a new password.
The reset link was sent to %1$s. The link is valid for 30 minutes.
Not in your inbox? Check the spam or promotions folder.
Make sure the email you typed is correct.
After saving, you are signed out of your other devices.
Does not match the new password yet
Sign in with your new password.
The reset link expired or was already used. Request a new one.

%1$d changes not yet sent will be sent after you sign in.

Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
Account deactivated. Data on this device stays safe.
Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
Sign-up isn't open yet. Please try again later.
Your account is ready. Open the link we sent to %1$s to verify your email. The link works for 24 hours.
Your starter credits arrive as soon as your email is verified.
Trips, packing and expenses already work.
%1$s is now linked to your account. Welcome to RANSEL!
This verification link no longer works
It is older than 24 hours, or a newer link was sent. Send a new link and open the newest one.
A new link is on its way. Check your email.
Sign in to get a new link
Verify your email to use Explore
We sent a link to %1$s. Once your email is verified, your Explore credits arrive right away.
The link works for 24 hours. Sending a new one cancels the old one.
Everything else works while you wait.
Not verified yet. Open the link in your email first.
Password does not meet the rules yet.
Sign in to open your trips
The web app works with your account.
Sign in to back up your trips and open them on other devices.
Offline · changes are saved on this device
Trips of this account are removed from this device. They stay in your account.
%1$d changes are not sent yet and will be lost on this device.
Changes stay on this device and are sent automatically when you are online.
%1$s can no longer open this trip and their old invite stops working.
%1$s will be able to invite, change roles and delete the trip. You become an editor.
The trip disappears from your list. To come back, you need to be invited again. Records stay for the other members.
Only the owner can invite people or change roles.
Owner · full access, including inviting people and deleting the trip.
Editor · changes the itinerary, packing and expenses.
Viewer · view only, still takes part in splitting costs.
Could not save the change. Try again.
No connection. Try again when you are online.
Anyone with the link can join
Can change the itinerary, packing and expenses

Link %1$s has reached its limit. Ask the trip owner for a new one.

The fewest transfers, worked out from all expenses.
What the payers paid must add up to the amount.
All shares must add up to the amount.

Save this list as a template

Reuse this list for your next trip.

Places you save go into the Unscheduled box of that trip.
Finished trips and trips you can only view are not shown.
No plan yet? Start from a destination and dates.
Start a new trip, then find places to visit for it.
Filled in from trip %1$s. Change it to explore somewhere else; dates still follow the trip.
Fill in the destination and dates, then tell us what you like. The trip is created when you tap the button below.
Filled in from the destination. You can change it later in Edit trip.
The trip appears in My trips right away with your default currency.
Could not create the trip. Please try again.
E.g. travelling with a small child, avoid heavy trekking
Recommendations are made on our server, so you need an account. Once is enough.
Tell us your budget and interests, then swipe to keep places.
Saved places go into your trip
They appear right away under Unscheduled in the itinerary.
Trips, packing and expenses on this device move to your account.
Everything else keeps working without an account.
Looking for places that match your interests…
%1$d places went to Unscheduled in %2$s. Plan the days whenever you like.

Hours can change, check Google Maps before you go.

Notifications are kept for 90 days after you read them.
News from your trips shows up here: friends joining, shared expenses and reminders before you leave.
You were removed from the trip
%1$s items are not packed yet. Departure is tomorrow.
Friends joining, voting requests and results, your role changing, or being removed.
Shared expenses that include you, and payments marked as settled.
Packing the evening before departure (18:00) and 30 minutes before an activity.
You are never notified about things you did yourself. Reminder times use Western Indonesia Time (WIB).
Notifications are off on this phone
You still get everything in the Notifications inbox, but not as pop-ups.
Get told when a friend joins, a shared expense is added, and before you leave. You can change this or turn it off any time in Account.
You liked %1$d of %2$d places. %3$s decides which ones go into the itinerary. The result shows once voting closes.
Places go to "Unscheduled". Voting closes right away.
